name: ITE Tech. Inc
summary: ITE Tech. Inc engages in the design and development of PC and mobile phone controller chips in Taiwan, Asia, and internationally. The company provides computer chipsets, super input/output integrated circuits, highly integrated circuits, integrated circuits and system products for RISC computers or computers, integrated circuits and system products for data communication, integrated circuits and system products for digital televisions, integrated circuits and module products for flash memory control.
